name: lv_obj_scroll_to

ownership.argument: Borrowed live page-owned LVGL object/event/input device; output coordinate buffer borrowed for call; no retention.

provenance.source: Exact absolute-scroll primitive runtime 0x1c02ddb0, Thumb callable 0x1c02ddb1; XIP veneer 0xc588800 targets it. Startup 0xc0c0ac8 copies [0x2c10d440,0x2c18d940) to PSRAM 0x3c000000, executable alias 0x1c000000, mapping load 0xc13b1f0 to runtime 0x1c02ddb0. Registers r0=obj,r1=absolute x,r2=absolute y,r3=anim. At 0x1c02ddce it computes current_x-requested_x and calls bounded relative-scroll 0x1c02d860 at 0x1c02ddd6; 0x1c02ddea similarly computes current_y-requested_y. Stock callers 0x1c02ed84,0x1c078388,0x1c0783b0 explicitly pass (obj,0,0,0) to restore zero offsets. The former load address 0xc13aca0 maps to relative-scroll 0x1c02d860, which returns immediately for zero deltas and is not this absolute operation.

notes: Target-private native UI host only. Static recovery does not grant public callable approval or device verification.
